title.narrative: Support and sponsorship of orphans in the Republic of Mali

description.narrative: - A cash guarantee provided to the orphan, which will be delivered every three months for a full year. Payment of fees and registration of orphans between the ages of 7 to 15 years. Economic empowerment of orphaned families by empowering and training women in sewing skills, providing them with empowerment tools, and distributing sheep to the poorest and most needy families.
1,000 orphans receive financial support, and tuition reimbursement 195 women trained in sewing skills 122 of the families of orphans will be provided with sheep.
Providing financial support to sponsor orphans and economic empowerment of orphaned families in the Republic of Mali.
